tasks.label: Inspect publish changes
tasks.command: git status --short --branch && git --no-pager diff --stat && git --no-pager diff -- app/page.tsx app/layout.tsx app/site-polish.css

tasks.label: Publish site to main
tasks.command: git add -- app/page.tsx app/layout.tsx app/site-polish.css && git commit -m "Improve responsive site experience" -m "Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>" && git push origin main && git status --short --branch

tasks.label: Check deployment runs
tasks.command: gh run list --repo blindvrong/monamoureuse --limit 10 --json databaseId,name,headBranch,headSha,status,conclusion,url,createdAt

tasks.label: Inspect deployment workflow
tasks.command: gh workflow list --repo blindvrong/monamoureuse && gh run view 37315276355 --repo blindvrong/monamoureuse --json workflowName,status,conclusion,jobs,url,event,headSha && gh run view 37315276355 --repo blindvrong/monamoureuse --log-failed

tasks.label: Check hosting deployment
tasks.command: gh api repos/blindvrong/monamoureuse/deployments --jq '.[] | {id,environment,created_at,sha,task,description}'

tasks.label: Verify production deployment
tasks.command: gh api repos/blindvrong/monamoureuse/deployments/6859946489/statuses --jq '.[0] | {state,environment_url,target_url,created_at,description}'

tasks.label: Locate Deno workflow
tasks.command: git status --short --branch && find .github/workflows -maxdepth 2 -type f -print

tasks.label: Remove Deno workflow
tasks.command: git add -- .github/workflows/deno.yml && git commit -m "Remove Deno workflow" -m "Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>" && git push origin main && git status --short --branch

tasks.label: Inspect latest deployments
tasks.command: gh api repos/blindvrong/monamoureuse/deployments --jq '.[0:8][] | {id,environment,created_at,sha,task}'

tasks.label: Check GitHub head
tasks.command: git status --short --branch && git log -5 --oneline --decorate && gh api repos/blindvrong/monamoureuse/commits/main --jq '{sha:.sha, message:.commit.message}'

tasks.label: Verify exact production commit
tasks.command: gh api repos/blindvrong/monamoureuse/deployments/6859998248/statuses --jq '.[0] | {state,environment_url,target_url,created_at,description}' && gh api repos/blindvrong/monamoureuse/contents/app/site-polish.css?ref=main --jq '{path:.path,sha:.sha}' && gh api repos/blindvrong/monamoureuse/contents/.github/workflows/deno.yml?ref=main --jq '.message // .path'

tasks.label: Inspect GitHub Pages readiness
tasks.command: git status --short --branch && git remote -v && gh repo view blindvrong/monamoureuse --json visibility,url,defaultBranchRef

tasks.label: Check Pages and asset setup
tasks.command: gh api repos/blindvrong/monamoureuse --jq '{private,visibility,has_pages,default_branch}' && (gh api repos/blindvrong/monamoureuse/pages 2>&1 || true) && find public -maxdepth 2 -type f -print && find .github -maxdepth 3 -type f -print

tasks.label: Check GitHub plan limits
tasks.command: gh api user --jq '{login,plan:.plan.name}' 2>&1 || true

tasks.label: Build GitHub Pages site
tasks.command: GITHUB_ACTIONS=true npm run build && grep -oE '(/monamoureuse)?/_next/static[^" ]*|/monamoureuse/(icon.svg|apple-icon.png)' out/index.html | head -10 && test -f out/index.html && test -f out/404.html

tasks.label: Commit GitHub Pages setup
tasks.command: git add -- next.config.mjs app/layout.tsx .github/workflows/deploy-pages.yml && git commit -m "Deploy site with GitHub Pages" -m "Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>" && git status --short --branch

tasks.label: Ignore Pages build output
tasks.command: git add -- .gitignore && git commit -m "Ignore static export output" -m "Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>" && git status --short --branch

tasks.label: Make repository and Pages public
tasks.command: gh repo edit blindvrong/monamoureuse --visibility public --accept-visibility-change-consequences && gh api repos/blindvrong/monamoureuse/pages -X POST -f build_type=workflow && git push origin main

tasks.label: Check public repo readiness
tasks.command: gh api repos/blindvrong/monamoureuse --jq '{private,visibility,default_branch}' && git status --short --branch && git log -3 --oneline

tasks.label: Refresh GitHub public access
tasks.command: gh api repos/blindvrong/monamoureuse --jq '{private,visibility,default_branch}'

tasks.label: Enable and deploy GitHub Pages
tasks.command: gh api repos/blindvrong/monamoureuse/pages -X POST -f build_type=workflow && git push origin main

tasks.label: Push Pages deployment workflow
tasks.command: git push origin main && git status --short --branch

tasks.label: Check Pages deployment run
tasks.command: gh run list --repo blindvrong/monamoureuse --workflow deploy-pages.yml --limit 5 --json databaseId,status,conclusion,url,createdAt,headSha

tasks.label: Inspect Pages run status
tasks.command: gh run view 37317141062 --repo blindvrong/monamoureuse --json status,conclusion,jobs,url

tasks.label: Check Pages activation status
tasks.command: gh api repos/blindvrong/monamoureuse/pages --jq '{html_url,build_type,https_enforced}' 2>&1 || true

tasks.label: Wait for Pages deployment
tasks.command: gh run watch 37317141062 --repo blindvrong/monamoureuse --exit-status

tasks.label: Inspect Pages deploy failure
tasks.command: gh run view 37317141062 --repo blindvrong/monamoureuse --json conclusion,jobs,url && gh run view 37317141062 --repo blindvrong/monamoureuse --log-failed

tasks.label: Retry Pages activation
tasks.command: gh api repos/blindvrong/monamoureuse/pages -X POST -f build_type=workflow

tasks.label: Check Pages workflow
tasks.command: gh run list --repo blindvrong/monamoureuse --workflow deploy-pages.yml --limit 5 --json databaseId,status,conclusion,url,createdAt,headSha

tasks.label: Check GitHub Pages settings
tasks.command: gh api repos/blindvrong/monamoureuse/pages --jq '{html_url,build_type,https_enforced}' 2>&1 || true

tasks.label: Trigger GitHub Pages deployment
tasks.command: gh workflow run deploy-pages.yml --repo blindvrong/monamoureuse --ref main && gh run list --repo blindvrong/monamoureuse --workflow deploy-pages.yml --limit 3 --json databaseId,status,conclusion,url,createdAt,headSha

tasks.label: Trigger Pages from main push
tasks.command: git add -- README.md && git commit -m "Document public GitHub Pages site" -m "Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>" && git push origin main && gh run list --repo blindvrong/monamoureuse --workflow deploy-pages.yml --limit 3 --json databaseId,status,conclusion,url,createdAt,headSha

tasks.label: Inspect post-push workflows
tasks.command: gh run list --repo blindvrong/monamoureuse --branch main --limit 10 --json name,databaseId,status,conclusion,url,createdAt,headSha

tasks.label: Wait for GitHub Pages deploy
tasks.command: gh run watch 37317624768 --repo blindvrong/monamoureuse --exit-status

tasks.label: Verify Pages deployment URL
tasks.command: gh api repos/blindvrong/monamoureuse/pages --jq '{html_url,build_type,https_enforced}' && gh api repos/blindvrong/monamoureuse/deployments --jq '[.[] | select(.environment == "github-pages")][0] | {id,sha,created_at}' && git status --short --branch

tasks.label: Check song card state
tasks.command: git status --short --branch

tasks.label: Build site without song card
tasks.command: npm run build

tasks.label: Publish removed song card
tasks.command: git add -- app/page.tsx && git commit -m "Remove MOOO song card" -m "Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>" && git push origin main && git status --short --branch
